local function sendToWebhook(hook, content)

local function getServers(gameid, cursor)
    local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" ..
    gameid .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&excludeFullGames&limit=100"
    if cursor then
        url = url .. "&cursor=" .. cursor
    end
    local response = HttpRequest({
        Url = url,
        Method = "GET",
        Headers = {
            ["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
        },
    })

    if response.StatusCode == 200 and response.Body then
        local decoded = nil
        pcall(function()
            decoded = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(response.Body)
        end)
        if decoded and decoded.data then
            return decoded
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function GetAllServers()
    local allServers = {}
    local nextCursor = nil
    repeat
        local data = getServers(PlaceId, nextCursor)
        if data and data.data then
            for _, server in ipairs(data.data) do
                if server then
                    table.insert(allServers, server)
                end
            end
            nextCursor = data.nextPageCursor or nil
        else
            nextCursor = nil
        end
    until not nextCursor
    return allServers
end

local function FindBestServer(servers)
    if not servers or #servers == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local bestServer = nil
    local highestPlayerCount = 0

    for _, server in ipairs(servers) do
        if server and server.id and server.playing and server.playing > highestPlayerCount then
            bestServer = server
            highestPlayerCount = server.playing
        end
    end

    return bestServer
end

local function serverhop()
    local servers = GetAllServers()
    if servers and #servers > 0 then
        local bestServer = FindBestServer(servers)
        if bestServer and bestServer.id and bestServer.id ~= JobId then
            task.spawn(function()
                if executewebhook and bestServer.ping then
                    sendToWebhook(executewebhook, bestServer.ping)
                end
            end)
            TPS:TeleportToPlaceInstance(PlaceId, bestServer.id)
        end
    end
end

local function Format(Int)
    return string.format("%02i", Int)
end

local function convertToHMS(totalSeconds)
    local Hours = math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600)
    local Minutes = math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60)
    local Seconds = math.floor(totalSeconds % 60)
    return Format(Hours) .. ":" .. Format(Minutes) .. ":" .. Format(Seconds)
end

local function SendStats()
    local health = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health or nil

    local gameTime = Workspace.DistributedGameTime

    local killsValue = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Kills.Value or nil
    local DeathValue = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Deaths.Value or nil
    local PlayersTable = Players:GetPlayers()

    local Parts = #Workspace:GetDescendants()
    local HMtime = os.date("%I:%M %p")

        DeathValue .. " Deaths",
        health .. " Health",
        Parts .. " Parts",
        framepersec .. " Fps",
        ping .. " Ping",
        formattedtime .. " ElapsedTime",
        HMtime .. " Clock"
    }
    local content = table.concat(contentParts, ", ")
    sendToWebhook(executewebhook, content)
end

local function gamepass(plr)
    if plr == LocalPlayer or Whitelist(plr.Name) then return end
    local url = "https://inventory.roblox.com/v1/users/" .. plr.UserId .. "/items/GamePass/915049131"
    local noob, response = pcall(function()
        return HttpRequest({ Url = url, Method = "GET" })
    end)
    if noob and response.StatusCode == 200 then
        local data = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(response.Body)
        if data and data.data then
            for _, item in ipairs(data.data) do
                if item.type == "GamePass" then
                    print("GamePass found in " .. plr.Name .. "'s inventory!")
                    table.insert(proplayer, plr.Name)
                end
            end
        end
    else
        warn("Failed to fetch data: " .. (response and response.StatusMessage or "Unknown error"))
    end
end
